definitionFields.abilityText: After you move, you may choose another friendly squadron at distance 1. That squadron performs an attack against an enemy squadron at distance 1 with an anti-squadron armament of 2 blue dice.
During your activation, you may spend 1 defense token to ignore engagement until the end of your activation.

While attacking a squadron during your activation, at the end of the Resolve Damage step, you may choose up to 2 enemy squadrons at distance 1 of the defender. If the defender was damaged, the chosen squadrons suffer 1 damage.
Before another friendly squadron at distance 1 suffers damage during an attack, you may spend 1 defense token to reduce the total damage by 1.
While attacking a ship, if another friendly squadron with bomber is at distance 1 of the defender, you may change 1 die to a face with a Accuracy icon.

Before a friendly squadron with ESCORT at distance 1 suffers damage during an attack, you may reduce the total damage by 1. If you do, choose a frienly squadron with ESCORT at distance 1. That squadron suffers 1 damage.
When you activate, choose 1 enemy ship or squadron at distance 1. That ship or squadron suffers 1 damage.
While attacking, if you have 6 or fewer hull points remaining, you may add 1 blue die set to the :accuracy: icon to your attack pool.
While a friendly ship is attacking a ship at distance 1 of you, it may change 1 die to a face with an :accuracy: icon.
While you are defending, the attack is treated as obstructed.
During your activation, instead of attacking, you may choose 1 friendly squadron at distance 1-2. That squadron may perform an attack (even if it has already activated).
While attacking, each of your :crit: icons adds 1 damage to the damage total.
While attacking a unique squadron, each of your :crit: icons adds 1 damage to the damage total.
While attacking, you may reroll 1 die for each enemy squadron or enemy ship at distance 1.
While attacking, if you are touching the defender, you may suffer 1 damage to add 1 die to your attack pool of a color that is already in your attack pool.
While another friendly squadron is at distance 1-2, it has COUNTER 1 or increases its COUNTER value by 1.
While you are defending, if the attack is obstructed, you may force the attacker to reroll 1 die of your choice.
Your attacks cannot be obstructed.
When a squadron you attack suffers at least 1 damage, you may toggle its activation slider to the activated side. If it was already activated, it suffers 1 additional damage instead.

When you are chosen to activate by a Squadron command, after the activation is resolved, choose up to 2 non-unique squadrons at Distance 1. The chosen squads may activate as if they were chosen by the Squadron command.
When an enemy squadron with INTEL or RELAY at distance 1 activates, it suffers 1 damage.
While attacking a ship or squadron with no readied defense tokens, each of your Crit adds 1 damage to the total.
At the start of the Ship Phase, you may activate as if you were activated by a :squadron: command.
Before an enemy ship or squadron at distance 1 moves, you may perform an attack against that ship or squadron even if you are engaged.
At the start of the Squadron Phase, choose up to 2 friendly squadrons at distance 1-2. Those squadrons gain ROGUE until the end of the round.
While a friendly squadron that has ESCORT is at distnace 1-2, it has ADEPT 1

During your activation, instead of attacking, you may toggle the activation slider of 1 squadron at distance 1 to the activated side. If it was already activated, you may place it anywhere at distance 1 of you.
While another friendly squadron with SWARM at distance 1 is attacking a squadron, it may add 1 blue die to its attack pool.

At the start of the Squadron Phase, you may toggle your activation slider to the activated side. If you do, you may perform an anti-squadron attack against each enemy squadron at distance 1. Treat these attacks as obstructed.
You ignore the escort and counter keywords on enemy squadrons.
While attacking a unique squadron during your activation, you may deal 1 damage to another friendly squadron at distance 1 of the defender. If you do, you may change 1 die to any face.
While a friendly squadron at distance 1-2 is defending, it can spend your defense tokens.
While attacking a ship, you may spend 1 die with a :crit: icon. If you do, the defender gains 1 raid token of your choice.
While an enemy squadron is at distance 1, its speed is reduced by 2 to a minimum of 1.
While attacking a ship, if the defending hull zone has no shields, you may reroll any number of dice in your attack pool.
After you perform an attack, you may move up to distance 1, even if you are engaged.
When you spend a defense token, you may discard it. If you do, reduce the total damage by 3 instead of resolving that token's effect.

While attacking, you may discard a defense token to set 1 die to any face. That die cannot be modified again.
While defending you may spend 1 of your defense tokens to force the attacker to reroll 1 or more dice of your choice.
While another friendly squadron with swarm at distance 1 is attacking a squadron, it may reroll 1 die (in addition to any dice rerolled from swarm).
When attacking a ship, treat the defender as having no shields.
While an enemy squadron at distance 1 is attacking an non-unique, friendly squadron, the attack is treated as obstructed.
While attacking, you may change 1 die to a face with a :crit: icon.
Friendly squadrons at distance 1 can attack enemy ships at close range using all dice in their battery armament.

Once per activation, while a friendly ship is attacking a ship at distance 1 of you and you are engaged by 1 or fewer squadrons, the attacker may spend 1 die to change 1 die to a face with a :crit: icon.
At the start of the Squadron Phase, you may toggle your activation slider to the activated side. If you do, you may place 1 proximity mine token at distance 1.
When a friendly ship resolves a squadron command, if you are in range to be activated, up to 3 of the squadrons with BOMBER it activates can be at distance 1-3 of you.
After you move, each squadron engaged with you suffers 1 damage.
When an objective token at distance 1-2 and not on an obstacle is moved or removed from the play area, you may move up to distance 1 and attack as if you were activated.
While attacking, you may spend 1 defense token to reroll any number of dice in your attack pool. When you activate, you may recover 1 of your discarded defense tokens.
Friendly squadrons with Bomber at distance 1 gain: ":crit:: The defending hull zone loses 1 shield."
Blue :crit: : If the defender is a ship, you may choose and discard 1 of its defense tokens.
While attacking, if you moved during this activation, you may reroll up to 2 dice.
After an enemy squadron ends its activation at distance 1, that squadron suffers 1 damage.
Non-unique, friendly squadrons without counter at distance 1 gain counter 1.
While performing a counter attack, each :crit: icon adds 1 damage to the damage total.
After a squadron you are engaged with performs a non-COUNTER attack, it suffers 1 damage if it did not attack you.

While you have a readied defense token, you gain ESCORT.
After defending against an attack, if you discarded a defense token, you may recover up to 3 hull (even if you would be destroyed).
While attacking a squadron, you may spend 1 blue die with a :crit: icon. If you do, each other enemy squadron at distance 1 of the defender suffers 1 damage.
You are not prevented from moving or attacking ships while you are engaged.
While an enemy squadron is engaged with another squadron, it cannot attack you.
During the squadron phase, you cannot attack unless you are performing a COUNTER attack.
While attacking an activated squadron, you may add 2 blue dice to your attack pool.
After defending against an attack, if you spent a defense token, you may move up to distance 1, even if you are engaged.
While attacking, you may choose another friendly squadron at distance 1. If you do, that squadron suffers 1 damage and you may reroll any number of attack dice
